label: after
source: example: the made-up notebook server, after its description rewrite
instructions: Notebook holds the user's personal notes. Find a note with search_notes when the user remembers its content, or list_notes when they name a folder or tag; read it with get_note. Ids come from those results, never guessed.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description:
Lists notes by where they are filed: a folder, a tag, or the newest overall. Returns titles and ids, not bodies.

When NOT to call: looking for words or a topic inside notes (search_notes); an id in hand (get_note).

folder.description: Only notes in this folder, by its exact name.

limit.description: At most this many notes; default 20.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description:
Finds notes whose title or body contains the given words. Use it when the user remembers what a note said or was about, not where it is filed. Returns titles, ids and a matching snippet.

When NOT to call: a folder or tag named exactly (list_notes); an id in hand (get_note).

query.description: Words to look for in titles and bodies.

limit.description: At most this many results; default 10.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description:
Reads one note in full, by id: title, body, folder and tags.

When NOT to call: no id yet (search_notes or list_notes first).

id.description: The note's id, from list_notes or search_notes.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description:
Creates a new note. Use only for a note that does not exist yet.

When NOT to call: changing, retagging or appending to an existing note (update_note).

folder.description: The folder to put it in; omitted means the inbox.

tools.name: update_note
tools.description:
Changes an existing note by id: its title, its body, or its tags. Fields left out are kept. tags replaces the whole list, so include the existing tags you want to keep.

When NOT to call: a new note (create_note).

id.description: The note's id, from list_notes or search_notes.

title.description: A new title; omitted keeps the old one.

body.description: A new body, replacing the old one; omitted keeps it.

tags.description: The full new tag list, replacing the old one; omitted keeps it.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Deletes one note by id, permanently. Only when the user asks for it to be deleted.

id.description: The note's id, from list_notes or search_notes.
